task.concept: relationship between MST characteristics and conventional network measures

method.concept: simulated regular and scale-free networks that were gradually rewired to random networks.

contribution.concept: MST is insensitive to alterations in connection strength or link density.

simulated regular and scale-free networks that were gradually rewired to random networks: although most connections are discarded during construction of the MST, MST characteristics were equally sensitive to alterations in network topology as the conventional graph theoretical measures.
MST characteristics diameter and leaf fraction were very strongly related to changes in the characteristic path length when the network changed from a regular to a random configuration.
MST degree, diameter, and leaf fraction were very strongly related to the degree of scale-free networks that were rewired to random networks.
